notes: 40315 quadruples, one from each of the 40315 classes of the cited enumeration, from the authors' dataset and stored in canonical form. The published equivalence also identifies the cyclic shift of a single block by n/2 and the negation of every second entry of all four blocks, which the board's does not: each of these classes splits into as many as 32 classes under the board's equivalence, more than the 5000 up to which a catalogue lists them all. The count here is a lower bound on the board's classes. No search was rerun for this entry.
